# Otimização de RNA

Considerando:

![](images/clipboard-1935277996.png)

```{r}

library(tidyverse)

f <- function(x1, x2){
  x1^4 + x2^4 + x1^2*x2 + x1*x2^2 - 20*x1^2 - 15*x2^2
}
```

## Letra A

Curvas de nível de f(x1,x2)

```{r}

grid <- expand.grid(
  x1 = seq(-4, 4, by = 0.02),
  x2 = seq(-4, 4, by = 0.02)
) |>
  as_tibble() |>
  mutate(z = f(x1, x2))

ggplot(grid, aes(x = x1, y = x2, z = z)) +
  geom_contour_filled(bins = 30) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(x = "x1", y = "x2", fill = "f(x1,x2)") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}

grid <- expand.grid(
  x1 = seq(-5, 5, by = 0.02),
  x2 = seq(-5, 5, by = 0.02)
) |>
  as_tibble() |>
  mutate(z = f(x1, x2))

ggplot(grid, aes(x = x1, y = x2, z = z)) +
  geom_contour_filled(bins = 30) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(x = "x1", y = "x2", fill = "f(x1,x2)") +
  theme_minimal()
```
